en.title: The Hard Thing About Hard Things
en.summary: Ben Horowitz, cofounder of Andreessen Horowitz and one of Silicon Valley's most respected and experienced entrepreneurs, offers essential advice on building and running a startup—practical wisdom for managing the toughest problems business school doesn’t cover, based on his popular ben’s blog. While many people talk about how great it is to start a business, very few are honest about how difficult it is to run one. Ben Horowitz analyzes the problems that confront leaders every day, sharing the insights he’s gained developing, managing, selling, buying, investing in, and supervising technology companies. A lifelong rap fanatic, he amplifies business lessons with lyrics from his favorite songs, telling it straight about everything from firing friends to poaching competitors, cultivating and sustaining a CEO mentality to knowing the right time to cash in. Filled with his trademark humor and straight talk, The Hard Thing About Hard Things is invaluable for veteran entrepreneurs as well as those aspiring to their own new ventures, drawing from Horowitz's personal and often humbling experiences. 该内容由淘宝网乐读书屋提供

recommendations.scoreReason: 嘉宾明确强烈推荐，并给出高度评价
recommendations.quoteEn: The Hard Thing About Hard Things by Ben Horowitz, such a great book, great again about mindset of how to approach hard things. Second is I'm a huge fantasy sci-fi fan, so I love Brandon Sanderson's books. I highly recommend those to people as well.
recommendations.quoteZh: 本·霍洛维茨（Ben Horowitz）的《关于困难的事情的困难》（The Hard Thing About Hard Things）是一本很棒的书，再次讲述了如何处理困难事情的心态。其次，我是一个奇幻科幻小说的超级粉丝，所以我喜欢布兰登·桑德森的书。我也向人们强烈推荐这些。
recommendations.questionEn: All right. First question, what are two or three books that you've recommended most to other people?

recommendations.guestBlurb: 马特·莫查里（Matt Mochary）是一位知名的高管教练。

episodeTitle.en: How to work through fear, give hard feedback, and doing layoffs with grace | Matt Mochary
episodeTitle.zh: 如何克服恐惧、给予坦诚反馈，并优雅地进行裁员 | 马特·莫查里

recommendations.scoreReason: 嘉宾在节目推荐环节中明确提到
recommendations.quoteEn: So, I picked up a book, a business book, it was High Output Management by Andy Grove. I read it and I was like, "Oh my God, here are all the answers." And then I read another book, The Hard Thing About Hard Things by Ben Horowitz was like, "Oh my God, there are even more answers." I just kept reading more and more business books, and every one I read, they were just chock full of answers. But then I needed to test whether or not these really worked, so that's when I started coaching and I started testing them in companies, but I had to let the people know here, do this, but they weren't going to read a 350 page book. I had to summarize it in two pages and then share it with them, and then they did, and then they implemented it and it worked.
recommendations.quoteZh: 于是我拿起一本商业书籍——安迪·格鲁夫的《高效能人士的七个习惯》。我读完后惊呼：“天哪，所有问题的答案都在这里！”接着我又读了本·霍洛维茨的《最难的事》，心想：“哇塞，答案更多了！” 我不断研读商业书籍，每本都充满了宝贵的经验。但要验证这些方法是否有效，我必须亲自实践。于是我开始做教练，带着企业家们一起验证这些方法。但我得让他们明白：去试试这个方法吧！可他们根本不愿意通读350页的书籍。我必须把精华浓缩成两页，然后分享给他们。结果他们真的照做了，而且效果显著。
recommendations.questionEn: Amazing. That was a fruitful question from Leo, and we might come back to this topic.
